schematic.mermaid_source:
flowchart TB
    %% LEVEL 1: TOP PLATFORM (EXTERIOR)
    subgraph LevelTop["LEVEL 1: TOP PLATFORM (EXTERIOR)"]
        Solar["2x 50W Solar Panels"]
        Ant4G_1["4G Antenna 1"]
        Ant4G_2["4G Antenna 2"]
        AntLoRa_A["LoRa Antenna A"]
        AntLoRa_B["LoRa Antenna B"]
        UV["Everbeam 50W UV Light"]
        Cam["IMX378 Vision Camera"]
    end

    %% LEVEL 2: BUOY FRAME (INTERNAL DRY BOXES)
    subgraph LevelInternal["LEVEL 2: INTERNAL TOWER (DRY BOXES)"]
        subgraph ZoneC["Zone C: Power Box"]
            MPPT["Victron MPPT 75/15"]
            Batt["50Ah LiFePO4"]
            FuseBlock["6-Way Marine Fuse Block"]
            RelayA_In["Relay A: 12V DC Switch"]
        end
        subgraph Networking["Networking Stack"]
            Router4G["4G Industrial Router"]
            Switch["5-Port Ethernet Switch"]
        end
        subgraph ZoneA["Zone A: Mission Box"]
            Pi5["Raspberry Pi 5"]
            ArdA["Arduino Mega Main"]
            EthA["W5500 Eth Shield"]
            RS485["USB-to-RS485"]
            subgraph UV_Logic["UV Timer Cascade"]
                T1["Timer 1"]
                T2["Timer 2"]
                T3["Timer 3"]
                RelayB["Relay B (AC)"]
                RelayS["Relay Safety"]
            end
            Inverter["300W Inverter"]
        end
        subgraph ZoneB["Zone B: Health Box"]
            Pi3["Raspberry Pi 3 B+"]
            ArdB["Arduino Mega Health"]
            EthB["W5500 Eth Shield"]
        end
    end

    %% LEVEL 3: SUBMERGED CAGE (IN WATER)
    subgraph LevelWater["LEVEL 3: SUBMERGED CAGE (WATER)"]
        EZO_Probe["Atlas Industrial EC"]
        DO_Sensor["Optical DO Sensor"]
    end

    %% CONNECTIONS
    Solar -- "2 Wires (P1)" --> MPPT
    Ant4G_1 & Ant4G_2 -- "2 Coax (P2)" --> Router4G
    AntLoRa_A -- "1 Coax (P3)" --> Pi5
    AntLoRa_B -- "1 Coax (P4)" --> Pi3
    RelayS -- "3 Wires AC (P5)" --> UV
    Pi5 -- "1 USB (P6)" --> Cam
    FuseBlock -- "2 Wires" --> ZoneA
    FuseBlock -- "2 Wires" --> ZoneB
    FuseBlock -- "2 Wires" --> Networking
    RelayA_In -- "2 Wires" --> Inverter
    Switch -- "RJ45" --> Pi5
    Switch -- "RJ45" --> Pi3
    Switch -- "RJ45" --> EthA
    Switch -- "RJ45" --> EthB
    Router4G -- "RJ45 (8W)" --> Switch
    ArdA -- "4 Wires (P7)" --> EZO_Probe
    RS485 -- "4 Wires (P8)" --> DO_Sensor
    ArdA -- "2 Wires" --> UV_Logic
    ArdA -- "1 Wire" --> ResetB["Reset B"]
    ArdB -- "1 Wire" --> ResetA["Reset A"]

    style Solar fill:#4a90e2,color:#fff
    style UV fill:#4a90e2,color:#fff
    style LevelWater fill:#1b3a5c,color:#fff
    style RelayS fill:#d9534f,color:#fff
    style Inverter fill:#e8a33d,color:#000
    style T1 fill:#4caf50,color:#fff
    style T2 fill:#4caf50,color:#fff
    style T3 fill:#4caf50,color:#fff

shopping_list.item_ru: Оцинкованная рама (готовая к миссии, для замены)
Морской силикон Sikasil Marine (высокотемпературный, чистый силикон)
shopping_list.notes: Using the highest-temperature Sika variant. Rated -50 to +180 °C continuous. No frame temperature measurement needed — silicone isn't being painted over, so the higher temp headroom is free and removes guesswork.
